title: Account Credit Deposit Volume and the Domain Care Price Match of Manual Renewals (Domain Registrations)
content:
**Training note, Domain Care programme, Domain Registrations.** The manual line's volume credit is one of the charge's Domain Care credits of a manual renewal charge. It is read from the account credit deposits on the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts account.

### What is the rule?

The manual line's volume credit is **USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered** where the account credit deposits posted on the customer's account less than 12 whole months before the day of the price match total **USD 5000.00 or more**; **USD 0.25 for each year the charge covered** where they total at least **USD 250.00** but less than USD 5000.00; and **nothing** where they total less than USD 250.00. A month counts only once its day of the month is reached.

### Which deposits count?

Only deposits of account credit posted on the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts account, and only those posted less than 12 whole months before the day of the price match. Other ledger entries on the account are not deposits and are not added.

### How is the 12-month edge read? (hypothetical dates)

For a price match made on 19 June 2029:
- a deposit posted on 20 June 2028 lies 11 whole months back (the twelfth month is not complete until 20 June 2029), so it counts;
- a deposit posted on 19 June 2028 lies 12 whole months back, so it does not count.

### Where are the band edges?

| Deposits in the window total | Volume credit |
|---|---|
| USD 5000.00 or more (USD 5000.00 itself included) | USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered |
| USD 250.00 up to USD 4999.99 | USD 0.25 for each year the charge covered |
| USD 249.99 or less, or no deposits | nothing |

### Hypothetical example

Deposits of USD 180.00 and USD 95.00 inside the window total USD 275.00, which is in the middle band; on a manual renewal charge that covered 3 years the volume credit is three times USD 0.25, that is USD 0.75.
